_doc: Setne's Tomb (DEEDS_KARMA_DESIGN 11.12; ENCOUNTER_STORIES_DRAFT H00 and C19). Engine settings and engine lines for src/setne_tomb.py. The encounter itself (the scene, the senet quiz with per_miss, the oath thoth_return, the forgo, the schedule of the dead) is ordinary encounter data under the tag in 'encounter', marked callback_only so nothing else rolls it: this system places it in a sealed tomb room on one run-rolled floor. The Book of Thoth has no other source.
atmosphere: The air on this floor smells of river mud and myrrh.
door_message: A door of black stone that was never meant to open swings inward at your touch.
read_spent_message: The words are still there. They will not do it twice.

altar.unread_message: Not yet. You swore to read it first.
altar.on_time_message: The book is wet when you lay it down, though it was dry in your pack. When you look again, it is gone, and the altar smells of river.
altar.on_time_chronicle: Laid the Book of Thoth on an altar, as I swore to a dead prince. It was wet when I set it down. Then it was gone home.
altar.late_message: I took the book back late. On the altar it was wet, and for a moment I heard a woman say a child's name.
altar.late_thread_line: I took the book back late. On the altar it was wet, and for a moment I heard a woman say a child's name.
altar.late_chronicle: Laid the Book of Thoth on an altar, later than I swore. It went home anyway. I think someone was waiting up.
